ideas.title: Cast your own lead plates in the beach: press a pattern, pour, dig out what you made
ideas.goal: Press anything into damp sand (a plank end, a stone, your own foot, a cart wheel), melt lead from the scrap heap over the fire, pour it into the hole and dig out a metal copy of exactly the hole you made. The battery's plates, a weight, a medal for a friend: whatever shape you press is what you get, and a sloppy mould gives a sloppy casting.
ideas.toward: The accumulator's lead plates (road: 'Lead plates in acid') made by the player, from the same sand field the cart sinks in.
ideas.idea: Green-sand casting on the real sand field: press! already leaves the exact cast of any body; damp sand holds steeper walls (capillary cohesion) so the mould keeps its shape where dry sand slumps it shut. Molten lead (327 C, 11.3 t/m3) fills the cavity as a heightfield liquid running downhill until its level is flat, cools by conduction into the sand (freezing front), and the solid casting is a mesh lifted from the filled cells: a real body with that mass. Watchers see orange metal creeping into a footprint, crusting grey, and Lumi pulling a lead bird-foot out of the sand.
ideas.form: Plugin on the beach (sand field + fire + lead scrap); a traced short at dusk: press, pour, glow, dig out.

ideas.title: Rock it free: heave on the beat with the friends
ideas.goal: When the yacht sits in its own holes, a single shove is not enough; push and let go in time with how it rolls back off the front wall and three friends join your 'heave!' Get the rhythm right and it climbs out a little higher each time; wrong and it settles deeper. A skill you feel in your hands.
ideas.toward: The big goal's 'the friends get off and push' moment, as play instead of a cutscene.
ideas.idea: The wheel in its hole is a real oscillator: the solved rim force (Bekker on the pressed front and rear walls, load history) is the restoring force, the cart's mass the inertia, and each rock presses the walls further (the hole widens into a ramp). Friends push with the Mohr-Coulomb grip of their own hooves and listen for Lumi's call. Watchers see the cart sway, a wheel ride up the wall, fall back, then over.
ideas.form: Step of the stuck project in Jump in; a traced short of the rocking breakout.

ideas.title: Singing sand: the beach squeaks under wheels and feet
ideas.goal: Dry sand sings when it shears: walk fast and it chirps, drag the cart and it moans, wet sand stays silent. The player hears how hard the wheels are working and where the dry patches are before they bog.
ideas.toward: The cart's sand: a sense of the soil the player uses to choose where to roll and lay planks.
ideas.idea: Squeaking/booming sand is real (grain size 0.2-0.4 mm, dry, shear rate above ~10/s): the Wong-Reece shear under each wheel and the friends' feet already gives slip velocity and normal stress per contact; their product drives a granular stick-slip oscillator whose pitch follows grain size and shear rate (booming dunes ~70-110 Hz, squeak ~500-2000 Hz), damped by moisture from beach_weight. Synthesised live, positioned in 3D.
ideas.form: Sound system plugin (a kind I have barely made); a short film with the sound on, cart moaning through dry sand.

ideas.title: A plank under the wheel
ideas.goal: Carry a plank from the woodpile, shove it under a bogged wheel, and the wheel climbs onto it; badly placed, it tips, sinks at one end, or squirts out. Two planks make a track you can leapfrog forward.
ideas.toward: The plank road on the dune (road step) and the stuck project.
ideas.idea: The plank rests on the sand field by Bekker (plank_rest exists), see-saws under the wheel's moving load, and the wheel's rim meets the plank's top as ground. Lumi's beak and feet carry and shove it (a held body). Watchers see a plank's far end lift as the wheel rolls on.
ideas.form: Stuck project step in Jump in; traced short.

ideas.title: The tide comes for the yacht
ideas.goal: The sea rises and falls over the day. Park on the wet band and the tide floats your friends' picnic away and buries the wheels in soupy sand; wait for low tide and the band is a hard road. The player plans trips by the tide.
ideas.toward: The daily rhythm of the big goal (weather and time decide the trip).
ideas.idea: A real tide level drives the sea plane and the water table in the sand field: cells under water are saturated (low Bekker k, near-zero friction angle), the band above it damp and firmest, dry above. Waves run up by slope. Watchers see the waterline creep up to the wheels.
ideas.form: World system (sea + sand field); a time-lapse traced film of a tide around the yacht.

ideas.title: The canvas glows: rebuild the yacht as a real built thing
ideas.goal: The yacht you sail looks like a boat someone made: laced canvas that lets the sun through and bellies in the wind, a mast stepped through the deck with stays, spoked wheels on real hubs and axles.
ideas.toward: The cart itself: frame, axles, wheels (road), and the look the posts need.
ideas.idea: Parts generated as assets (hub, spokes, rim, mast step, canvas texture) assembled part by part on the existing yacht; Hikari thin diffuse-transmission material for the canvas so backlight glows through, the sail mesh bent by the solved pressure. Watchers see sun through canvas at dusk.
ideas.form: Assets + materials on the yacht; a traced still into the sun.

ideas.title: Lumi digs like a bird: beak scoops, flying sand, a hole you can see
ideas.goal: When you press R, Lumi bends, scoops with its beak and flings the sand over its shoulder; you see every scoop land and the hole deepen.
ideas.toward: Digging in the stuck project, and Lumi's own body (goal 6).
ideas.idea: A dig pose driven by the scoop's real volume; the removed cells become sand grains thrown ballistically (a few hundred particles) that land on the field at the heap cell. Low sun shows the hole.
ideas.form: Animation + particles; a close traced short.

ideas.title: Tug of war on the beach: friends vs the bogged cart
ideas.goal: Tie a rope to the bow; the friends line up and pull, feet sliding in dry sand, gripping on wet. Who stands where changes who wins.
ideas.toward: Friends hauling the cart (road: the friends push/pull it).
ideas.idea: A rope as a tension chain; each friend's pull capped by its feet's Mohr-Coulomb shear on the soil under it (dry slips, wet grips); slipping feet leave furrows in the field.
ideas.form: Plugin in Jump in; traced short of a line of friends leaning back.

ideas.title: Planté fizz on the bench: form a lead plate by charging it
ideas.goal: Two lead plates in acid on the bench; charge them from the windmill and watch the plus plate turn brown and fizz; the more cycles you give it, the more it holds.
ideas.idea: Electrochemistry of Planté forming: PbO2 layer growth per cycle, gassing above 2.4 V, capacity from formed layer thickness; bubbles from the real current.
ideas.form: Bench plugin; traced close-up of bubbling plates.

ideas.title: Footprints tell who passed
ideas.goal: Every creature leaves its real footprint in the sand field; read the beach in the morning to find who went where in the night, and follow a friend's tracks to where it hid.
ideas.toward: The same sand field everywhere on the beach (needed for the cart's long ruts).
ideas.idea: Each foot presses the field with its real shape and weight (hoof, bird foot, paw); the beach-wide field wakes in tiles; wind slowly smooths old tracks.
ideas.form: World system; a traced morning still of tracks.
